name: Shimodori Fuuka
source:
Fuuka is an unfortunate girl who had closed her heart from the world due to suffering from a heavy disease and a complicated domestic environment. She finds her pleasure only in reading.
Her father is a single parent, and he is currently working abroad. She is now being hospitalized in the Umegaoka Hospital, during her staying she had built a good relationship with nurse [url=/c4989]Fujimaru[/url].
After encountering Jilld she started to regain the energy to live little by little...

Favourite Book: The Neverending Story
A place she'd like to visit: A place in the wild where penguins live.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
